decisions.reason: As a recent 2019 launch closely tied to the firm's infrared heating line, management is likely to give the low-noise burner more time and explain weak traction by temporary market conditions rather than abandon it quickly.
Because the gas infrared plaque heater received its own webpage, the firm has made a relatively visible commitment and is therefore likely to persist with it despite any disappointing early results.

The gas infrared luminous radiant heater fits the firm's core product area, so management would be inclined to continue with it and justify slow sales as part of a still-maturing product introduction.

As a core heating product launched only shortly before the disrupted 2020-2021 period, the gas-fired infrared tube heater would likely be retained while management attributes underperformance to temporary factors.
The standard gas infrared plaque heater appears to have received a strong public presentation, which raises the need for managerial justification and makes withdrawal less likely in the near term.

Even if results have been unclear, this gas-fired infrared tube heater remains close to the firm's established capabilities, so escalation of commitment makes continued market presence more likely than immediate withdrawal.
